properties.note: Pre-reaction complex: CH2=O with CH3NH2 held by the n(N)->pi*(C=O) contact and an N-H...O contact. B3LYP-D3(BJ)/def2-SVP, gas phase, 0 imaginary frequencies. Lowest-energy verified minimum of the reactant state (other evidence conformers: species/RC_c1.log -210.217581299 Ha, 0 imag; species/RC_c0.log -210.217587139 Ha with one floppy imaginary mode, not a clean minimum).

Concerted addition saddle (N-C bond formation + N-H -> O proton transfer, 4-membered array). Frequency log: ts/ts_0001/jobs/declaration_0005/frequency/frequency.log; IRC: ts/ts_0001/jobs/declaration_0006/irc/irc.log. Both IRC branches independently optimized to zero-imaginary-frequency minima with the declared RC and I1 identities (ts_prepare verdict: verified).

Carbinolamine (hemiaminal) HOCH2-NHCH3, 0 imaginary frequencies. Also reached as the IRC target minimum of step e1 (-210.237884833 Ha, ts/ts_0001/jobs/declaration_0006/product_frequency/product_frequency.log).

Uncatalysed four-centre dehydration saddle candidate of the carbinolamine: C-O cleavage with synchronous N-H -> O proton transfer (reaction centre (1,2) C-O break, (3,5) N-H break, (2,5) O-H form, C-N order up). Frequency log ts/ts_0002/jobs/declaration_0003/frequency/frequency.log (exactly one imaginary mode, -2469.2 cm-1, dominated by the transferring proton); opt log ts/ts_0002/jobs/declaration_0003/ts_opt/refine.log. The connection to I1 could NOT be proven: three IRC attempts (ts/ts_0002/jobs/declaration_0004/irc/irc.log default 20 points, /declaration_0005/irc/irc.log 50 points, /declaration_0006/irc/irc.log irc=(calcfc,stepsize=5,maxpoints=40)) all left both branches on the product/dissociated side - the final outer frames (ts/ts_0002/verdict/irc_end_a.xyz, irc_end_b.xyz, both E ~ -210.194 Ha, ~27 kcal/mol above I1) are unrelaxed mid-IRC geometries. The saddle is therefore a candidate for this elementary step, not a verified one, and its 86.3 kcal/mol barrier should be read as an upper bound for the uncatalysed 4-centre elimination in gas phase.

Channel-specific reactant complex of the water-assisted dehydration: hydrogen-bonded carbinolamine-water complex (14 atoms, single dot-joined complex node). 0 imaginary frequencies; alternative conformer water_channel/RCW_25_optfreq.log -286.616853910 Ha.

Water-mediated six-membered proton-shuttle saddle for carbinolamine dehydration (proxy for the acid/base-assisted route available at pH 4-6). Frequency log ts/ts_0003/jobs/declaration_0004/frequency/frequency.log; IRC ts/ts_0003/jobs/declaration_0005/irc/irc.log; the IRC outer frames optimized to the carbinolamine-water complex and the imine + two-water complex.
Channel product: imine + two-water complex (14 atoms), 0 imaginary frequencies. IRC-reached conformer -286.609733590 Ha (ts/ts_0003/jobs/declaration_0005/product_frequency/product_frequency.log).

edges.note: candidate-only: rank-1 saddle with the intended reaction centre, but the I1 connection is not proven by IRC (see TS2 note).
